The self-report claims the dedupe row is "persisted before the charge," but the reviewer note contends it's written *after* the charge call, which would leave a crash-mid-call double-charge window unaddressed. These accounts directly conflict on the central correctness property.

The self-report (SELF) is uncorroborated and self-interested. The "all 96 tests pass" claim is asserted but not backed by an admissible CI artifact (REC/PROOF), so it cannot independently confirm the ordering. The reviewer note (WIT), though informal and unverified, identifies a specific, plausible ordering defect that would defeat the acceptance criteria if true.
